aboutIntro.label: Sembule Media · Kampala, Uganda
aboutIntro.title: The crew you forget was there.
aboutIntro.description: Since 2022, Sembule Media has run cameras, streams, sound and screens for conferences, weddings and documentaries across Uganda. You look after your guests. We look after everything they see and hear.
aboutIntro.imageAlt: Sembule Media crew running a multi-camera livestream from a boardroom control desk

callToAction.title: Is your date still free?
callToAction.description: Send the date and the venue. We’ll tell you if we’re available and what the room will need. No full brief required.

hero.label: Our team
hero.title: We worry about the details, so you don’t have to.
hero.description: Based in Bunamwaya, Kampala, Sembule Media works with events, organizations and communities across Uganda.

story.label: Since 2022
story.title: Good production is mostly invisible.
paragraphs: Sembule Media started in 2022 to bring live video, streaming, sound and PA, photography, videography and documentary work under one roof. You deal with one crew, not five suppliers who have never met.
Every job starts with the same three questions: what is the room, who is the audience, and what should be remembered? The equipment follows from the answers, not the other way round.
story.imageAlt: Sembule Media crew running a multi-camera livestream from a boardroom control desk

values.title: Plan for the room
values.description: We look at the venue, the audience and the running order first. Then we choose the equipment and crew.

values.title: Coordinate the details
values.description: We talk to your event team before the day, so nothing gets decided for the first time on the morning.

values.title: Deliver what was agreed
values.description: Formats, timing and scope are agreed up front, so the hand-over holds no surprises.

coverage.label: Where we work
coverage.title: Based in Kampala. Available for productions across Uganda.
coverage.description: A city hotel or a village hall: tell us where it is and what you need. We’ll confirm availability and logistics before you commit to anything.

statement.description: A livestream, a sound system and a documentary look like different jobs. They succeed or fail for the same reasons: preparation, coordination and delivering what was promised.

callToAction.label: Start a conversation
callToAction.title: Tell us the date. We’ll do the worrying.

hero.label: Sembule Media services
hero.title: Choose the outcome. We’ll bring the equipment.
hero.description: Nobody books a sound system because they want a sound system. They want to be heard. Tell us what the day needs to achieve, and we’ll plan everything from the first sound check to the final edit around it.

items.title: Livestreaming & broadcast
items.description: Much of your audience may never set foot in the venue. Multi-camera coverage, live switching and recording carry the event to them, and leave you a full recording when it’s over.

items.title: Corporate events
items.description: A conference is judged by its worst five minutes. Clear sound, readable screens and dependable coverage for conferences, launches, meetings and workshops, so the room remembers your message rather than the technical pause.

items.title: Sound & PA
items.description: Nobody remembers good sound. Everyone remembers feedback and a dead microphone. We scope the system around your venue and audience, indoors or out, so people talk afterwards about what was said.

items.title: Documentaries & field stories
items.description: People support what they can see. Story-led filming and post-production that shows the work, the community and the people behind it, in their own words.

items.title: NGO work
items.description: Donors, partners and communities believe what they can see. Programme films and field stories, coverage of launches, dialogues and workshops, and livestreams for the people who couldn’t travel.

items.title: Photography
items.description: The event lasts a day. The pictures keep working for years: in the annual report, the next proposal, the website. Conferences, launches, portraits and weddings.

items.title: Videography
items.description: Highlight films, interviews, brand films and podcasts, filmed and edited by the crew that ran the day, so nothing is lost between the shoot and the edit.

items.title: 65-inch TV display hire
items.description: Big enough for the back row to read your slides. Availability, transport and setup are confirmed with each enquiry.

callout.title: Not sure what you need? Most people aren’t.
callout.description: Tell us the date, the venue and roughly how many people. We’ll suggest the setup. Knowing the equipment is our job, not yours.
